title: 第19章 差点被抓到第20章 知书达理的女人
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
王美琴身材丰腴，经过昨晚的事情之后，她发现自己今天气色都变好了，肌肤看上去白里透红，好像浑身经脉都被打通了一样。
她现在三十几岁，正是一个女人如狼似虎的年纪，感觉李大炮就算是一头牛，她都能吃得下去。
“王姨，你又来找李大炮给你换灯泡吗？”
孟晚晴问道，昨天换个灯泡换了一个多小时，不知道换什么灯泡这么费力。
“哪能天天换灯泡，我家还有几只鸡找不到了，我让大炮帮我去找一找。”
王美琴说道，这可是她想了一天才想到的借口，不然实在不知道该怎么把大炮骗回家。
“这黑灯瞎火的……”
“王姨，还没有睡觉啊。”
“大炮，你回来了，跟我走，我有点事找你帮忙。”
王美琴一把拉住李大炮的手，把他拉走了，留下生气的孟晚晴。
“这一个个的，都把大炮当成免费的劳工了吗？”
孟晚晴愤愤不平，她自己家还要暖被窝，还要耕田种地呢，怎么能让别人天天晚上勾搭走。
她决定以后要看牢一点，天黑了就关门，谁来都不好使。
李大炮很快来到王美琴家里。
“王姨，今晚还换灯泡吗？”
“傻小子，换什么灯泡。”
“王姨，你……”
李大炮瞪大了眼睛，怎么王美琴今天连灯都不关，这是不打算演了吗？
王美琴的姿色可不是张婶能比的，而且她年纪也不大，保养的也挺好，肌肤充满了弹性。
王美琴似乎是觉得李大炮今天都没有乱说话，应该也不用顾忌那么多，因此也就不关灯了。

大不了事后再交代他几句，应该不会出什么事。
咚咚咚！咚咚咚！
一个小时后，外面突然有人在敲门，不是李大柱，而是王美琴的男人李长胜。
他是偷偷从卫生院跑出来的，似乎觉得这样就不用付医疗费了。
“美琴，美琴，赶紧开门。”
李长胜喊道，看着房间里灯火通明，隐约看到一个晃动的人影，瞬间有一种被偷了家的感觉。
“不好，这个死鬼不是在卫生院吗？怎么跑回来了？”
王美琴一阵惊慌，好在回来的比较晚，并没有破坏他们的好事。
“大炮，你先躲起来，你长胜叔回来了。”
王美琴说道，随后又把李大炮塞进了衣柜，这才去开门。
“这什么事，昨晚躲衣柜，今晚又躲衣柜。”
李大炮受不了了，趁着王美琴去开门，他溜了出来，然后从后门走了。
他前脚刚走，李长胜就操着一根棍子冲进了房间，然后四处找人。
“长胜，你发什么神经呢，你以为我跟你一样吗？在外面搞破鞋。”
王美琴开口嘲讽，她要找就找年轻小伙子，这才有干劲。
“王美琴，你别在这跟老子嘴硬，要是让我找到了人，我要你好看。”
李长胜骂骂咧咧，他在床底下，窗户外面四处察看，最后瞄准了柜子。
王美琴立即双手捂胸，感觉要完了。
但是下一刻她一脸懵逼，因为柜子里面只有衣服，并没有李大炮的人。
“这傻小子，难道自己跑了？”

王美琴一阵激动，还好跑掉了，不然事情就不好办了。
“李长胜，你有完没完？这日子还能不能过了？”
content_en:
Wang Meiqin has a plump figure. After what happened last night, she found that her complexion had improved today, and her skin looked white and rosy, as if all the meridians in her body had been opened.
She is now in her thirties, which is the age when a woman is like a wolf and a tiger. She feels that even if Li Dapao is a cow, she can eat it.
"Aunt Wang, did you come to Li Dapao to change the light bulb for you again?"
Meng Wanqing asked, it took more than an hour to change a light bulb yesterday. I don’t know why it took so much effort to change a light bulb.
"How can I change light bulbs every day? I still have a few chickens that I can't find. I asked Cannon to help me look for them."
Wang Meiqin said that this was an excuse that she came up with after thinking about it for a whole day, otherwise she really didn't know how to trick Cannon home.
"This is a fool's errand..."
"Aunt Wang, you haven't slept yet."
"Cannon, you are back. Come with me. I have something to ask you for help."
Wang Meiqin grabbed Li Dapao's hand and pulled him away, leaving an angry Meng Wanqing.
"Do all of these people regard cannons as free labor?"
Meng Wanqing was indignant. She had to keep her bed warm and farm the fields at home, so how could she let others hook up with her every night?
She decided to keep a tighter watch in the future and close the door when it gets dark so that no one can come in.
Li Dapao soon came to Wang Meiqin's house.
"Aunt Wang, do you want to change the light bulb tonight?"
"Silly boy, change the light bulb."
"Aunt Wang, you..."
Li Dapao's eyes widened. Why didn't Wang Meiqin turn off the lights today? Did he not plan to perform?
Wang Meiqin's beauty is not comparable to that of Aunt Zhang, and she is not very old, and she takes good care of herself, and her skin is full of elasticity.
Wang Meiqin seemed to think that Li Dapao didn't talk nonsense today, so he shouldn't have to worry so much, so he didn't turn off the lights.
At worst, if you tell him a few words afterwards, nothing will happen.
Boom, boom, boom! Boom, boom, boom!
An hour later, someone suddenly knocked on the door. It was not Li Dazhu, but Wang Meiqin's man Li Changsheng.
He ran away from the health center secretly, seemingly thinking that he would not have to pay for medical treatment.
"Mikoto, Mikoto, open the door quickly."
Li Changsheng shouted, looking at the bright lights in the room, he vaguely saw a shaking figure, and instantly felt as if his home had been stolen.
"No, isn't this damn guy in the health center? Why did he come back?"
Wang Meiqin panicked for a while, but fortunately she came back late and did not ruin their good deeds.
"Cannon, you hide first, your Uncle Changsheng is back."
Wang Meiqin said, then stuffed Li Dapao into the closet before going to open the door.
"What's this? I was hiding in the closet last night, and I'm hiding in the closet again tonight."
Li Dapao couldn't stand it anymore, so he slipped out while Wang Meiqin opened the door, and then left through the back door.
As soon as he left, Li Changsheng rushed into the room with a stick, and then looked around for someone.
"Chang Sheng, what's wrong with you? Do you think I'm the same as you? I break my shoes outside."
Wang Meiqin taunted, saying that if she wanted to find something, she would look for a young man, so that she could be motivated.
"Wang Meiqin, don't be so harsh with me here. If I find someone, I want you to look good."
Li Changsheng cursed, looking around under the bed and outside the window, and finally aimed at the cabinet.
Wang Meiqin immediately covered her chest with both hands, feeling that she was about to die.
But the next moment she was confused, because there were only clothes in the cabinet and no one from Li Dapao.
"This silly boy, did he run away by himself?"
Wang Meiqin was excited, but luckily she ran away, otherwise things would have been difficult to handle.
"Li Changsheng, are you done yet? Can you survive this day?"
